final: WITH type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_avg FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS baseline_avg FROM Products), above_baseline AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.type_avg, b.baseline_avg FROM type_averages t CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE b.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL AND t.type_avg > b.baseline_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg) AS kept_avg FROM above_baseline), remaining AS (SELECT a.type_avg, a.baseline_avg, m.kept_avg FROM above_baseline a CROSS JOIN kept_mean m WHERE a.type_avg > m.kept_avg) SELECT AVG(type_avg) AS avg_type_price, AVG(type_avg - baseline_avg) AS avg_above_baseline, AVG(type_avg - kept_avg) AS avg_above_kept_mean FROM remaining
